_comment: Mutation testing for the whole pure-TS domain (@oilio/shared) — utils, domain aggregates (reducers + replay), event-store, value objects, type validators. A surviving mutant = a behaviour no unit test pins. This package is where mutation pays off: pure logic, no Next/emulator, ~91% line coverage and a fast unit suite. The web is intentionally NOT mutated — its real net is the integration/e2e suite (Stryker reruns the unit suite per mutant; web unit coverage is ~14%, so mutating it would just yield no-coverage mutants).
_thresholds_comment: Whole-domain score (NOT cherry-picked) ≈ 77.4% after the 8-leva burndown. break = regression floor just below current; ratchet UP as survivors are killed. Remaining survivors are documented equivalents (INITIAL_* consts overwritten by `created`, deleted/default no-ops, type-unreachable guards) — ~77% is the honest plateau. Never set break above the real score to make it look good.
